body: Lanta is the slower Andaman island: space and a scooter week, not a party village. Stay north for boats and dinner. Stay south for empty sand. Koh Lanta is a long west-facing island, known for space and a slower Andaman week. It is not a village around one bay. Boats from Krabi Town (Klong Jilad) and Ao Nang (Nopparat Thara) land at Saladan from about November to April and take about 2 to 2.5 hours. From May to October those boats thin out or stop. The road still works: van to the mainland Hua Hin pier (this is not the gulf resort), a short car ferry to Lanta Noi of about 15 minutes, then the bridge onto Lanta Yai. Pair Lanta with Krabi or Phuket, not with Samui. The Andaman monsoon is the rule here. Koh Rok and Koh Haa snorkel boats follow the same winter window. Many south-end resorts close in the wet months. Check that your hotel is actually open. title: Khao Lak and the Similan Islands
sub: Khao Lak is a long, quiet Andaman beach, not a Phuket suburb. Sleep here for Similan mornings. Do not sleep here for nightlife.
body: Khao Lak is a long, quiet Andaman beach, not a Phuket suburb. Sleep here for Similan mornings. Do not sleep here for nightlife. Khao Lak is the long-beach Similan base in Phang Nga, north of the Sarasin Bridge. From Phuket Airport you drive Highway 402 off the island and north on Highway 4. Nang Thong is about 70 minutes without traffic. Bang Niang is a few minutes farther. Khuk Khak and Laem Pakarang sit later still. There is no airport and no ferry. It is a car. The Similan Islands are a national park, not a hotel strip. The Department of National Parks opens them from 15 October to 15 May and closes them from 16 May to 14 October every year so the reef can rest and so the southwest monsoon does not sink day boats. Buy the DNP e-ticket. Foreign adult park fees have been in the 500 THB range; confirm on the e-ticket site the week you go. Koh Tachai stays closed. Speedboats from Thap Lamu take about 1.5 hours. Phuket pickups add a long pre-dawn road. body: Pai is a mountain night after 762 bends, not a first-week must. The Mae Hong Son Loop is about 600 km. Give it four days or skip it. Pai is the mountain town at the end of Route 1095. sub: Sukhothai is lotus-bud chedis you ride between on a bicycle, not a Bangkok day trip. Sleep in Old Sukhothai. New Sukhothai is a taxi.

title: Ayutthaya
sub: Ayutthaya is the ruin day from Bangkok. Take the train from Krung Thep Aphiwat, move by bicycle or tuk-tuk, and leave on an afternoon train unless you want dawn.
body: Ayutthaya is the ruin day from Bangkok. Take the train from Krung Thep Aphiwat, move by bicycle or tuk-tuk, and leave on an afternoon train unless you want dawn. Ayutthaya is the island city of brick prangs and root-wrapped Buddhas, an hour north of Bangkok. The Fine Arts Department lists paid monuments at 80 THB each for foreign visitors or 300 THB as a flat ticket (Thai 10 / 40). The combo usually covers Wat Phra Si Sanphet, Wat Mahathat, Wat Ratchaburana, Wat Phra Ram, Wat Chaiwatthanaram, and a sixth site. Ask the booth which names are on today's stub. Hours on the department page read 08:00 or 08:30 to 18:00 or 18:30; Wat Phra Si Sanphet and Wat Ratchaburana often sell last tickets earlier. Office: 035 242 286. Ordinary and express trains still make Ayutthaya in about an hour from Krung Thep Aphiwat. SRT also runs commuter sets on this line. Weekend tourist extras appear and vanish; check the board, not a screenshot. From the station you need a tuk-tuk, a bicycle, or a long hot walk. Wat Chaiwatthanaram sits off the island to the west. Wat Mahathat's root-wrapped head is the photograph everyone already has. Go at opening if you want it without a queue. title: Kanchanaburi
sub: Kanchanaburi is the River Kwai town plus Erawan falls. Give it two nights if you want both. The bridge is a morning. Hellfire Pass and the seven tiers do not fit the same afternoon.
body: Kanchanaburi is the River Kwai town plus Erawan falls. Give it two nights if you want both. The bridge is a morning. Hellfire Pass and the seven tiers do not fit the same afternoon. Kanchanaburi is a river town west of Bangkok, not an island and not a ruin loop. The steel bridge and Khwae Yai Bridge station are the postcard. The Thailand-Burma Railway Centre and the allied war cemetery are the part that should take longer than the selfie. title: Scooters and road rules
sub: Scooters are how many visitors get hurt. A car licence does not cover a scooter, even a small automatic. You need a motorcycle licence and an International Driving Permit that lists motorcycles. If you cannot show both, take the van.
body: Scooters are how many visitors get hurt. A car licence does not cover a scooter, even a small automatic. You need a motorcycle licence and an International Driving Permit that lists motorcycles. If you cannot show both, take the van. Thai law does not split scooters out of motorcycles. A 110 cc Honda Click and a 400 cc bike both need a motorcycle endorsement. A 2026 scooter rental is often 200 to 350 THB a day plus petrol. The tourist path is your full home motorcycle licence carried with an International Driving Permit that lists category A (or the 1949 motorcycle class). Thailand accepts 1949 and, since May 2021, 1968 convention IDPs. The IDP is a translation. It cannot add a class you do not hold. A UK CBT is training, not a full licence. body: Kamala and Surin are known for quieter west-coast swimming between Patong and Bang Tao. Kamala suits families. Surin is the small white cove. The cliff road is Millionaire's Mile. Kamala and Surin sit on the central west coast, north of Patong and south of Bang Tao. They are the quieter Andaman stay if you still want an airport drive under an hour and a beach you can swim. This is not the Kata village strip and not the Laguna golf grid. November to April is the sea. The rest of the year is a discount and a less reliable swim. The Smart Bus from HKT is 100 THB. Surin Beach is about 45 minutes on the January 2026 timetable. Kamala (Big C) is about an hour. A car is 25 to 40 minutes in light traffic. Stay on the sand if you want to walk to dinner. Stay on the cliff if the villa view is the point and you accept a car for every meal. title: Rawai and Nai Harn
sub: Rawai and Nai Harn are known as the far-south end of Phuket. Swim at Nai Harn Lagoon. Eat and boat from Rawai. Walk Promthep Cape for sunset, not as a hotel base.
body: Rawai and Nai Harn are known as the far-south end of Phuket. Swim at Nai Harn Lagoon. Eat and boat from Rawai. Walk Promthep Cape for sunset, not as a hotel base. Rawai and Nai Harn are the far-south peninsula, past Kata. This is not a second Patong. Nai Harn is the swim. Rawai is the working waterfront: seafood, longtails, and a pier, not a postcard lagoon. Promthep Cape is the sunset viewpoint on the same headland. Give the cape a late afternoon, then leave. The Smart Bus is still 100 THB and takes about 2 hours 10 minutes to Rawai on the 2026 timetable. A car from HKT is 50 to 75 minutes. The airport limousine board listed about 900 THB to Rawai. Stay at Nai Harn if the beach is the trip. Stay in Rawai if the market and the boats matter more than the sand. title: Chaweng
sub: Chaweng is known for the 6 km east-coast strip, dinner, and nightlife. Sleep central if you want the reef swim and the road. Sleep Chaweng Noi if you want a quieter south pocket.
body: Chaweng is known for the 6 km east-coast strip, dinner, and nightlife. Sleep central if you want the reef swim and the road. Sleep Chaweng Noi if you want a quieter south pocket. Chaweng is Samui's main east-coast bay: about 6 km of white sand, the densest dinner row, and the island nightlife that is not a Full Moon. January to September is the easier Lower Gulf sea. October to December is wetter and windier. Fly USM. The airport taxi board lists about 400 THB to Chaweng, a 7 to 14 minute drive. There is no useful songthaew from the terminal. Book the car. Central Chaweng is the reef-protected swim and the loud road. Chaweng Noi is the quieter south pocket around the next headland. Do not book "Chaweng" as if every soi were the same volume. Beach clubs sit on the Samui nightlife page. Six Senses and Four Seasons are different coasts. Easier January to September (Lower Gulf) USM taxi board about 400 THB; 7 to 14 minutes About 6 km; centre is reef-protected Chaweng to Lamai about 50 to 60 THB, 20 to 25 minutes

title: Lamai
sub: Lamai is known as the calmer east-coast bay south of Chaweng. The water is deeper. Rates run lower. Come for Sunday walking street and Hin Ta Hin Yai, not for the Chaweng club row.
body: Lamai is known as the calmer east-coast bay south of Chaweng. The water is deeper. Rates run lower. Come for Sunday walking street and Hin Ta Hin Yai, not for the Chaweng club row. Lamai is the next east-coast bay south of Chaweng. It is the stay if you want white sand and dinner without sleeping on the island's main club road. The water is deeper than central Chaweng, so the swim feels less like a reef pool. Resort rates usually sit under Chaweng for a similar room. January to September is still the Gulf window. The USM taxi board lists about 700 THB to Lamai, 18 to 30 minutes. A daytime songthaew from Chaweng is about 50 to 60 THB if you agree the fare. Grab is the late option. Hin Ta and Hin Yai, the grandfather and grandmother rocks, sit on the south headland. They are a short stop, not a half-day. Sunday Walking Street is the weekly market on the Lamai road; go late afternoon, not at 21:00 when the useful food is gone. Easier January to September (Lower Gulf) USM taxi board about 700 THB; 18 to 30 minutes Lamai to Chaweng about 50 to 60 THB, 20 to 25 minutes Lamai Walking Street, late afternoon into the evening

title: Ari
sub: Ari is known for cafes and neighbourhood Thai kitchens on quiet sois west of Phahonyothin. Ride BTS Ari. Siam is about 15 minutes. This is not Sukhumvit nightlife.
body: Ari is known for cafes and neighbourhood Thai kitchens on quiet sois west of Phahonyothin. Ride BTS Ari. Siam is about 15 minutes. This is not Sukhumvit nightlife. Ari is the leafy North Bangkok neighbourhood around BTS Ari (N5). West of Phahonyothin, Soi Ari 1 to 4 is the walkable cafe and bar village. The streets stay low-rise. Siam is five Sukhumvit-line stops and about 15 minutes. A 2026 tap is about 32 to 37 THB. Stay here if you want coffee, a quieter night, and Thai kitchens that are not a Sukhumvit soi. Two 2026 Bib Gourmand rooms sit on this ridge. Lay Lao (Phaya Thai), 65 Soi Phahon Yothin 7, is Isan and Thai with Hua Hin seafood: order the deep-fried pork belly in Lay Lao sauce, fried squid with roe, and som tam, daily about 10:30 to 22:00, near BTS Ari. title: 10-Day Thailand Itinerary: Bangkok, Chiang Mai, one coast
sub: This is the classic first trip: city, north, one beach. Use the monsoon to pick Phuket and Krabi or Samui and Tao. Do not stack both seas.
body: This is the classic first trip: city, north, one beach. Use the monsoon to pick Phuket and Krabi or Samui and Tao. Do not stack both seas. The classic first trip is Bangkok, Chiang Mai, and one south coast. Ten nights is enough for that. It is not enough for two seas. Sleep three nights in Bangkok, three in Chiang Mai, then four on the coast the monsoon allows. Book hotel bases, not a new room every night. Fly the long legs. Bangkok to Chiang Mai is about 70 minutes. The useful night train is SRT 9 northbound (Krung Thep Aphiwat to Chiang Mai, about 18:40 to 07:15) and SRT 10 southbound (Chiang Mai to Krung Thep Aphiwat, about 18:20 to 06:30), about 12 hours, if you want to save a day-room. The south hop is a second flight: CNX or BKK to HKT or KBV in winter, USM in the Gulf summer. A 2026 BTS tap is 17 to 62 THB. Grand Palace is 500 THB. Wat Pho is 300 THB. Bangkok 3, Chiang Mai 3, one south coast 4 Phuket or Krabi Nov-Apr; Samui and Tao May-Sep BKK-CNX about 70 minutes, or SRT 9/10 about 12 hours Add a second sea or Pai on this spine

title: 2 weeks Andaman island hopping
sub: Two Andaman weeks, four island stops, one sea. Start at HKT or KBV. Finish at Pak Bara and fly out of Hat Yai. May to October is the wrong window.
body: Two Andaman weeks, four island stops, one sea. Start at HKT or KBV. Finish at Pak Bara and fly out of Hat Yai. May to October is the wrong window. Two Andaman weeks work if you move south once a stay, not twice a day. Start at Phuket or Krabi. Add Railay, a Phi Phi night, Lanta, then Lipe. End on the Satun mainland at Pak Bara and fly out of Hat Yai (HDY). Do not fly back to HKT the same afternoon the Lipe boat lands. Phuket passenger boats use Rassada Pier, not Patong Beach. Ao Nang boats use Nopparat Thara. Railay has no road: a shared longtail is about 10 to 15 minutes and 100 to 200 THB a person in 2026. Tigerline and Bundhaya are the high-season names that string Phi Phi, Lanta, and Lipe. Those legs cancel first when the Andaman is up. Check on arrival. title: 10 days Gulf islands: Samui, Phangan, Tao
sub: This Gulf hop is beach nights plus Tao diving. Fly into USM. Boat with Lomprayah. Skip it in November swell if you need a guaranteed sea.
body: This Gulf hop is beach nights plus Tao diving. Fly into USM. Boat with Lomprayah. Skip it in November swell if you need a guaranteed sea. Ten Gulf days work when each island has a role. Samui is the airport and the easy beach. Phangan is bays, not only Haad Rin. Tao is the Open Water card and the west-coast viewpoints. Lomprayah is the first boat to book. Seatran Discovery and Songserm are the backup desks, not a third sea. January to September is the easier Lower Gulf window. May to August is the calmest, clearest sea, when the Andaman parks are shut. October to December is swell season; fast boats cancel first. The Lomprayah Samui to Thong Sala catamaran is about 30 minutes. Seatran takes about 45. Phangan to Tao (Thong Sala to Mae Haad) is about 1 to 1.5 hours on Lomprayah: the catamaran about 1 hour, the midday ferry about 1.5 hours. Songserm and Seatran Discovery use the same piers; check the boat on the day. Tao collects about 20 THB on arrival. Read the Samui pier: Nathon for many Lomprayah tickets, Maenam / Pralarn for others, Bangrak for Seatran, Lipa Noi for Raja. title: 7 days Northern Thailand loop
sub: This north loop is Lanna wats, a mountain night in Pai, and Chiang Rai temples. Use Prempracha from Arcade Terminal 2. Use Green Bus VIP for Chiang Rai.
body: This north loop is Lanna wats, a mountain night in Pai, and Chiang Rai temples. Use Prempracha from Arcade Terminal 2. Use Green Bus VIP for Chiang Rai. Seven north days fit Chiang Mai, one mountain day, Pai, and Chiang Rai. They do not fit the full 600 km Mae Hong Son Loop. Sleep two nights in the Old City, take Doi Inthanon as a day, ride Highway 1095 to Pai, then Green Bus to Chiang Rai. Coffee highlands sit on the Inthanon road at Mae Klang Luang and again toward Doi Chang if you have a spare morning. Prempracha holds the licensed Pai vans (route 612). Arcade Terminal 2 is the usual counter; some tickets print Terminal 3. Walk-up fares sit around 210 to 250 THB. They take a passport number. Green Bus VIP 24-seat coaches leave Arcade Terminal 3 for Chiang Rai Terminal 1. Chang Phuak (Terminal 1) is the wrong station for both rides. Check on arrival. title: Similan and Surin Islands
sub: These parks are granite boulders, clear water, and Richelieu Rock liveaboards. Day boats leave Tab Lamu Pier. Sleep in Khao Lak, not Patong.
body: These parks are granite boulders, clear water, and Richelieu Rock liveaboards. Day boats leave Tab Lamu Pier. Sleep in Khao Lak, not Patong. Mu Ko Similan and Mu Ko Surin are separate national parks in the Andaman, not hotel islands. Both open 15 October to 15 May and close 16 May to 14 October so the reef can rest and so the southwest monsoon does not sink day boats. Foreign adults pay 500 THB at each park, children 250 THB. Divers often pay an extra daily fee. Buy the DNP e-ticket when the desk is live, and still carry cash. Similan day boats leave Tab Lamu Pier (also written Thap Lamu), south of Khao Lak in Thai Mueang. The run is about 70 km and about 1.5 hours by speedboat. Phuket pickups add a long pre-dawn road. Surin sits farther north. Khuraburi is the usual Surin pier. Richelieu Rock is a Surin pinnacle, not a Similan snorkel stop. If Richelieu is the point, book a liveaboard, not a Donald Duck Bay day boat. sub: Doi Inthanon is known for the 2,565 m summit, cloud-forest trails, and Wachirathan Falls. A Hmong guide on Kew Mae Pan is 200 THB per group. Leave Chiang Mai early.
body: Doi Inthanon is known for the 2,565 m summit, cloud-forest trails, and Wachirathan Falls. A Hmong guide on Kew Mae Pan is 200 THB per group. Leave Chiang Mai early. Doi Inthanon is the highest mountain in Thailand at 2,565 m, southwest of Chiang Mai on Highway 108 then 1009. The drive is 1.5 to 2.5 hours. Foreign adults pay 300 THB at the park gate, children 150 THB, plus 30 THB per car or 20 THB per motorbike. Keep the stub. Booths check it again higher up. The summit boardwalk at Ang Ka is short, cold, and often in cloud. Bring a jacket. 2,565 m, about 1.5 to 2.5 hours from Chiang Mai 300 THB foreign adult, 150 THB child, cash Open November to May; 200 THB Hmong guide per group Twin Royal Pagodas 100 THB, not in the park ticket

sub: Wat Pho is known for the 46-metre Reclining Buddha and Thailand's best-known massage school. Best as the second stop after the Grand Palace.
body: Wat Pho is known for the 46-metre Reclining Buddha and Thailand's best-known massage school. Best as the second stop after the Grand Palace. Wat Pho sits immediately south of the Grand Palace. Foreign adults pay 300 THB in 2026. Gates run 08:00 to 19:30, which makes this the late option if the palace queue ate the morning. The reclining Buddha is 46 metres long in the vihara on the northwest side. Coins for the 108 bronze alms bowls are sold at the door. Walk the row once; it is the point. The Wat Pho Thai Traditional Massage School is on the temple grounds, not a spa on Khao San. sub: Use Damnoen Saduak if you need a morning canal on any weekday. Use Amphawa if you want local seafood on a weekend evening. Maeklong trains pass at 08:30, 11:10, 14:30, and 17:40.

title: Chiang Mai ethical elephant sanctuaries
sub: Half-day and full-day observation-and-feeding sanctuaries sit in the Mae Wang and Mae Taeng valleys outside Chiang Mai. Book a no-hook, no-show camp if you want to watch and feed, not ride; the van is part of the 2026 price.
body: Half-day and full-day observation-and-feeding sanctuaries sit in the Mae Wang and Mae Taeng valleys outside Chiang Mai. Book a no-hook, no-show camp if you want to watch and feed, not ride; the van is part of the 2026 price. The useful Chiang Mai elephant day is a sanctuary that lets you walk, feed, and watch. It does not put you on a neck, in a howdah, or in a painting show. Mae Taeng is the northern valley. Mae Wang is south-west toward the Doi Inthanon roads. Half-day trips run 1,800 to 2,500 THB in 2026. Full days run 2,500 to 3,500 THB. Hotel pickup in a shared van is usually in the price. The drive is about 1 to 1.5 hours each way. A riding camp will still sell itself as a sanctuary. Ask three questions before you pay: Do guests ride? Are bullhooks on site? Are there circus tricks or painting? If any answer is yes, pick another desk. Mud spas and bathing can still stress animals when they are staged for cameras. Feeding platforms and long observation walks are the quieter model. Book direct or through a Klook listing that states no riding in the inclusions, not through a soi tout on Monday night. sub: The White Temple is known for Chalermchai Kositpipat's unfinished white ubosot, paired on the same day with the Blue Temple and Baan Dam. Best as a long day from Chiang Mai or one night in Chiang Rai, not a first-week add-on to Pai.

Best as a long day from Chiang Mai or one night in Chiang Rai, not a first-week add-on to Pai. Wat Rong Khun, the White Temple, is Chalermchai Kositpipat's unfinished art wat south of Chiang Rai city. Foreign adults pay 100 THB in 2026. Hours are 08:00 to 17:00. The bridge, the white ubosot, and the mural room are the visit. Dress like a temple: covered shoulders and knees. Drones and loud fashion shoots get stopped. Wat Rong Suea Ten, the Blue Temple, sits closer to the river in town and does not charge a foreign ticket. Baan Dam Museum, the Black House of Thawan Duchanee, is 80 THB north of the city and is a dark-wood compound, not a wat. Sleep in Chiang Rai if you want dawn at the White Temple without a 05:00 lobby call. title: Phang Nga Bay and James Bond Island
sub: Phang Nga Bay is known for Hong and Panak sea-canoe caves and the Koh Tapu needle. Best as an early Ao Po day from Phuket or Phang Nga, not a Patong beach.

Ao Phang Nga National Park is the drowned limestone bay north of Phuket. Foreign adults pay 300 THB. The postcard is Khao Phing Kan and the Koh Tapu needle, the 1974 James Bond island pair. The better hour is often a canoe into the tidal caves at Hong Island or Panak Island, where the roof opens onto a hidden lagoon. Koh Panyi is the floating Muslim village on stilts. Later boats spend the Bond stop in a queue of longtails. November to April is the Andaman window. May to October cancels more days. The 300 THB park fee is often extra to the Klook or hotel desk price. title: Phi Phi Islands and Maya Bay
sub: Maya Bay is known as the Phi Phi Leh cove you walk into from Loh Samah; swimming in the bay is banned. Best as a day boat with a swim at Pileh Lagoon or Bamboo Island, park fee 400 THB.
body: Maya Bay is known as the Phi Phi Leh cove you walk into from Loh Samah; swimming in the bay is banned. Best as a day boat with a swim at Pileh Lagoon or Bamboo Island, park fee 400 THB. title: Railay Beach and Phra Nang Cave
sub: Railay is known for Phra Nang Cave Beach and bolted limestone climbing on a roadless peninsula. Best for swimmers and climbers who will take the 15-minute longtail; West is the sunset swim, East is the boardwalk and mud flats.
body: Railay is known for Phra Nang Cave Beach and bolted limestone climbing on a roadless peninsula. title: Cheow Lan Lake, Khao Sok
sub: Come for Guilin-style limestone on a reservoir, not a Gulf beach. Charter a longtail from Ratchaprapha Dam. Overnight on a floating rafthouse if one day is not enough.
body: Come for Guilin-style limestone on a reservoir, not a Gulf beach. Charter a longtail from Ratchaprapha Dam. Overnight on a floating rafthouse if one day is not enough. Cheow Lan Lake (Rajjaprabha) is the flooded karst basin in Khao Sok National Park, Surat Thani. The public pier is at Ratchaprapha Dam, a different place from Khao Sok village on Highway 401. Foreign adults pay 300 THB at the park gate in 2026. A private longtail charter for the Three Brothers (Khao Sam Kler), a swim stop, and either Nam Talu Cave or Coral Cave runs 1,800 to 2,500 THB depending on hours and fuel. Shared tour boats are cheaper and stick to a script. Nam Talu is a wet cave that needs a guide and settled rain. Coral Cave is the drier alternative when the park has closed Nam Talu. Overnight rafthouses sit in the coves: a basic floating room is the point, not a resort spa. Night safaris and dawn mist are why people stay. November to April is the easier lake. October rain still closes caves. title: Sanctuary of Truth, Pattaya
sub: The Sanctuary of Truth is known for a 105-metre-high carved wooden hall on the Naklua waterfront, built of teak and other hardwoods with traditional joinery. Best as a Pattaya morning for a guided hard-hat walk, not a beach-club stop.
body: The Sanctuary of Truth is known for a 105-metre-high carved wooden hall on the Naklua waterfront, built of teak and other hardwoods with traditional joinery. Best as a Pattaya morning for a guided hard-hat walk, not a beach-club stop. The Sanctuary of Truth (Prasat Sut Ja-Tum) stands on the Naklua waterfront north of central Pattaya. The carved hall is 105 metres high and about 100 metres on each side. The main structure uses teak plus mai daeng, mai takien, and mai panchart, assembled with traditional wood joinery and no metal nails. Construction has been ongoing since the 1980s. Foreign daytime entry is 500 THB in 2026. Hours are 08:00 to 18:00, run as guided slots. You wear a helmet because this is still a worksite as well as a monument. An evening session with lights runs on selected nights; check the desk the week you go. Cover knees and shoulders. The same rule as a wat applies even though this is a private foundation, not a royal temple. Grab from Walking Street is 20 to 30 minutes depending on the beach road. A baht bus to Naklua is cheaper and slower. This is not a first-trip substitute for Ayutthaya or the Grand Palace. title: Rajadamnern and Lumpinee Muay Thai
sub: Rajadamnern is known for Thursday Petchyindee cards and Saturday RWS nights near Khao San. ONE Lumpinee on Fridays at the Ram Inthra stadium suits planners who want the Pink Line hall, not the old Rama IV venue.
body: Rajadamnern is known for Thursday Petchyindee cards and Saturday RWS nights near Khao San. ONE Lumpinee on Fridays at the Ram Inthra stadium suits planners who want the Pink Line hall, not the old Rama IV venue. Rajadamnern Stadium opened in 1945 on Ratchadamnoen Nok, a short Grab from Khao San and the Democracy Monument. Thursday Petchyindee cards and Saturday RWS (Rajadamnern World Series) nights are the useful 2026 products. Ringside and close-floor seats run about 1,500 to 3,500 THB depending on the card. Buy from the stadium or a Klook listing that names the exact date. A soi tout with a laminated card is how you overpay. Lumpinee Boxing Stadium is no longer on Rama IV. ONE Championship Friday nights run at the new Lumpinee on Ram Inthra, north-east Bangkok. The nearest rail is MRT Pink Line Ram Inthra 3 (PK17), about a 10-minute walk to the gate. title: Yaowarat Chinatown food walk
sub: Come for rolled noodles, claypot seafood, and late fried dough, not a mall court. Night walkers who pay cash after 18:00 fit this strip. Monday is the slow stall night.
body: Come for rolled noodles, claypot seafood, and late fried dough, not a mall court. Night walkers who pay cash after 18:00 fit this strip. Monday is the slow stall night. Yaowarat Road is the Chinatown dinner walk, not a lunch market. MRT Wat Mangkon Exit 1 puts you on the gold-shop strip. Stalls thicken after 18:00 and run hard until about 23:30. Last Blue Line trains are around midnight; plan a Grab if you stay later. Cash and PromptPay still beat most foreign cards. For where to sleep and the 32 THB MRT hop from Sukhumvit, use [Yaowarat access](/bangkok/chinatown-yaowarat). Monday is the street-stall slowdown. Shophouses and a few seafood rooms stay open. sub: Eat Phuket Town for Hokkien-Peranakan house cooking, not a Kata grill. Morning roti at 30 to 60 THB, evening porridge except Monday, and crab yellow curry in a Sino-Portuguese room.

title: Bangkok and Chiang Mai coffee guide
sub: Drink filter and espresso from northern Thai Arabica, not only instant on ice. This guide fits cafe hoppers in Ari or Nimman who will pay 80 to 160 THB and sit still for a pour-over.
body: Drink filter and espresso from northern Thai Arabica, not only instant on ice. This guide fits cafe hoppers in Ari or Nimman who will pay 80 to 160 THB and sit still for a pour-over. Thailand's specialty scene is highland Arabica from Chiang Rai (Maejantai village in Mae Suai District, Doi Chang, Doi Tung) and the Chiang Mai hills, roasted in city rooms. A 2026 filter or espresso is 80 to 160 THB. Iced is still the default; ask for hot if you want the origin. Factory Coffee sits near Phaya Thai ARL, useful on a Bangkok arrival day. Roots at The Commons Thonglor and Kaizen Coffee in Ekkamai are the Thonglor-Ekkamai evening pour-over strip. Graph Coffee Co. is a Chiang Mai roaster, not a Bangkok pin: Old City and One Nimman. Ari is the all-day cafe soi. Charoenkrung and Talat Noi mix roasters with river shophouses. In Chiang Mai, Akha Ama Coffee roasts Arabica from Maejantai village in Mae Suai District, Chiang Rai. Sit at Akha Ama Phrasingh on Ratchadamnoen Road, opposite Wat Phra Singh in the Old City, or at Akha Ama Living Factory on Hussadhisewee Soi 3 in Santitham. There is no Akha Ama cafe on Wat Ket. Ristr8to on Nimmanhaemin is the espresso and latte-art queue. Old City and Nimman both work; do not treat every wooden shop inside the moat as a specialty bar. Pair a Nimman afternoon with the [khao soi circuit](/thai-food/chiang-mai-khao-soi-and-markets), not with a farm class the same morning. sub: Thai beaches are known for three coasts with different dry months. Pick one sea first: Andaman November to April, Lower Gulf January to August, or the east coast November to April.

The Lower Gulf (Koh Samui, Koh Phangan, Koh Tao) stays drier January to August and takes its heaviest rain from October to early December. title: Thailand with kids and families
sub: Thailand with kids is known for shallow west-coast beaches, Chiang Mai ethical elephant half-days, and Bangkok aquarium breaks. Fits families who bring a travel car seat or book a private van.
body: Thailand with kids is known for shallow west-coast beaches, Chiang Mai ethical elephant half-days, and Bangkok aquarium breaks. Fits families who bring a travel car seat or book a private van. Thailand works for families because distances are short, food is mild if you ask, and hospitals in the main cities are used to foreign patients. The hard part is the road. Street taxis and many Grabs have no child seat and often no rear seatbelt you trust. Bring a travel car seat, or book a private Klook or Trip.com van that lists child seats (a 2026 BKK-to-hotel van is often 1,200 to 2,000 THB). Do not assume the airport taxi has one. Calm, shallow beaches for small kids: Kata, Kamala, and Bang Tao on Phuket; Choeng Mon on Samui; Klong Dao on Koh Lanta. Skip Patong and Chaweng as a first beach with toddlers. Chiang Mai ethical elephant half-days sit on [elephant sanctuaries](/attractions/chiang-mai-ethical-elephant-sanctuaries). Bangkok heat breaks: SEA LIFE Bangkok Ocean World at Siam Paragon. Hospitals: Bumrungrad and Samitivej in Bangkok; Bangkok Hospital Phuket and Bangkok Hospital Samui on the islands. sub: A Thailand honeymoon is known for a Chao Phraya stay, a jungle or Lanna pause, then a private-pool villa on Krabi, Phuket, Samui, or Koh Yao Noi. Fits couples who split 12 nights 3-4-5.
body: A Thailand honeymoon is known for a Chao Phraya stay, a jungle or Lanna pause, then a private-pool villa on Krabi, Phuket, Samui, or Koh Yao Noi. Fits couples who split 12 nights 3-4-5. A Chao Phraya river house is the first honeymoon lock: Capella, The Siam, or a Mandarin Oriental river room for three nights. Five north days are known for a Chiang Mai base and one Chiang Rai temple circuit. Sleep three nights in the [Old City](/chiang-mai/old-city) or Nimman. Walk Wat Chedi Luang and Wat Phra Singh. Use two nights in [Chiang Rai](/chiang-rai), or one full-day GreenBus VIP or private van if you refuse a second hotel. The [White Temple](/attractions/white-temple-wat-rong-khun-and-blue-temple) (Wat Rong Khun) is 100 THB, the Blue Temple (Wat Rong Suea Ten) is free, and Baan Dam (Black House) is 80 THB.
